s: Hello and welcome to Word Kitchen.
I am very well thank you.
Today we talk about our home.
A home is the place where we live.
My home is small, but I love it.
Let us walk through my home together and learn new words.
This is the room where we sleep.
In the bedroom there is a bed.
A bed is a thing you sleep on.
I sleep in my bed every night.
My bed is big and soft.
Near the bed there is a lamp.
Turn on the lamp at night.
The light from the lamp is warm and soft.
It helps me read my book.
On the wall there is a clock.
It is seven o'clock in the morning.
There is also a mirror in the bedroom.
Now let us go to the living room.
This is the room where we rest.
In the living room there is a sofa.
A sofa is a soft long chair.
I sit on the sofa and read a book.
Sometimes I sit on the sofa and drink tea.
There is a window in the living room.
A window is for looking out.
The window is big and bright.
You open it to go in
and you open it to go out.
The kitchen is the room for cooking.
In the kitchen there is a table.
The table is in the kitchen.
Put your plate on the table.
A plate is a thing you eat food from.
My plate is white and round.
I eat rice from my plate.
And there is a cup on the table.
A cup is a thing you drink from.
I drink tea from my cup.
Near the table there is a chair.
A chair is a thing you sit on.
Let us say all 12 words again.
Sofa, window, door, kitchen, table, plate, cup, chair.
sofa, window, door, kitchen, table, plate, cup, chair.
Your home is full of English words.
Point at things and say the words.
That is a great way to learn.
Learning at home is fun and easy.
Let me ask you, Lena, what is in your kitchen?
In my kitchen, there is a table, four chairs, and a big window.
And what is on your table right now?
On my table, there is a plate and a cup.
The plate is empty, and the cup is full of hot tea.
And in your bedroom, what do you see?
I see my bed, my lamp, my clock, and my mirror.
Now our listeners can do the same.
Look around your home and name everything in English.
Window, kitchen, lamp, sofa, cup, plate, clock, mirror.
You are learning more every day.
Thank you for listening to word kitchen.
Have a wonderful day at home.
